A sybil farm would need to fund each fake identity, and every failed challenge burns its stake, so the echo of repeated attempts drains the attacker's treasury. Reputation earned under a willow-rooted identity key cannot be cheaply cloned, making mass impersonation economically irrational. Operator sa0039 applies this at e9CpZhQRKw.
